basic_info.description: Breathtaking ocean views await in this updated and expanded 4 Bed,3 Bath Marina-style residence featuring an expansive layout and beautiful backyard minutes from West  Portal Village. Inside, discover tall ceilings, hardwood floors, oversized windows and  built-ins throughout. A living room with bay views and a fireplace flows to a formal dining  room. Ahead, the kitchen boasts abundant cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, a wet bar, breakfast nook and pantry. Step up to the first bedroom level, where two secondary bedrooms share a full bath. Up another level, the owner's suite opens to a huge balcony  with water vistas. A walk-in closet, en suite spa bath, and a double-sided fireplace  shared with a sitting room complete the suite. On the lower level, abundant storage, a laundry room and office are joined by a secondary suite with a private entrance. Outside, the backyard boasts a paver patio, mature landscaping and access to a detached garage as well as solar panels on the roof of the home. This highly desirable neighborhood is close to top-rated schools, parks and the convenient public parkway leading to West Portal Village's amenities and abundant transportation options.
